title: CareerLens Long-lived Role Contract v1
rules: A role is a user-configured persistence boundary with exactly one long-lived agent session.
tool_allowlist is intersected with the global tool registry: a role can only narrow tools, never grant an unregistered tool.
Write tools remain gated by the durable approval and tool ledger; a role does not bypass approval.
Every configuration update increments version; a run records the exact role version in its payload and never changes it.
Roles cannot create other roles, cannot send messages as another identity, and expose no external delivery tool.
An inactive or archived role rejects triggers; a revoked actor token pauses the role and records a failed occurrence.
The trusted gateway enforces the allowlist on both model tool offers and tool invocation; the CLI cannot widen it.
